remarks: Wonderful Cape, just waiting for you to call home! This delightful home features four spacious bedrooms, including a primary bedroom with en-suite, three well-appointed bathrooms, including one in the finished basement which also hosts the fourth bedroom, This property is a canvas awaiting your creativity! While in great condition, a touch of tender loving care can transform it into a masterpiece of living space. It's the  perfect fixer-upper for those looking to imprint their style without starting from scratch. Picture this: a cozy evening in your spacious living area or planting your dream garden in the welcoming backyard. This house  isn't just a dwelling; it's the heart of your next big adventure. Why just read about it when you can experience it all? This house is waiting to tell its next story-yours. With just a few repairs and a little love, this house could easily become your dream home. Schedule your showing, it's an opportunity you won't want to miss. Sold AS IS.
